run-by-universiti-sains-malaysia-most-k0: Run by Universiti Sains Malaysia. Most calls come from hospitals and clinics, and some from households and workplaces. Outside those hours, call 999 in an emergency.
ambulance-and-medical-emergencies-for-a-: Ambulance and medical emergencies. For a fire, call 119; for the police, 110.

police-fire-medical-and-disaster-respons: Police, fire, medical and disaster response; free, 24 hours.
national-poison-management-and-control-c: National Poison Management and Control Center (UP-PGH)
run-by-the-philippine-general-hospital-o: Run by the Philippine General Hospital, University of the Philippines Manila.

national-poisons-information-centre-npic: National Poisons Information Centre (NPIC), AIIMS New Delhi
run-by-the-all-india-institute-vyngk4: Run by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences for the whole country. It advises the public as well as health workers.
poisons-information-centre-christian-med: Poisons Information Centre, Christian Medical College (CMC), Vellore
doctors-trained-in-clinical-toxicology-a: Doctors trained in clinical toxicology answer, for the public as well as health workers, from anywhere in India.
poison-information-centre-jss-college-of: Poison Information Centre, JSS College of Pharmacy, Mysuru
monday-to-friday-9-00-to-1kzpu8c: Monday to Friday 9:00 to 17:00, Saturday 9:00 to 13:00, free

for-the-public-in-the-charotar-16upncu: For the public in the Charotar region as well as health workers. Opened in March 2026.

ambulance-for-the-police-call-999-1r0lfh: Ambulance. For the police, call 999; for a fire, 997.
medical-emergencies-free-for-the-police-: Medical emergencies; free. For the police, call 19, or the Gendarmerie Royale on 177; for a fire, the civil protection service on 15 or 150.
poison-control-and-pharmacovigilance-cen: Poison Control and Pharmacovigilance Centre of Morocco (Centre Anti Poison et de Pharmacovigilance du Maroc, CAPM)
a-doctor-judges-how-serious-the-s3t1hq: A doctor judges how serious the poisoning is and gives first-aid advice.

civil-protection-protection-civile-also-: Civil protection (Protection civile); also 1021. For the police, call 17 or 1548; for the gendarmerie, 1055.
suwa-seriya-ambulance-free-around-the-1n: Suwa Seriya ambulance: free, around the clock, across the island. For the police, call 119; for a fire, 110. Those two numbers are from an ITU list last updated in 2012.
ambulance-and-medical-emergencies-for-th: Ambulance and medical emergencies. For the police, call 100; for a fire, 101. These numbers are from an ITU list last updated in 2012.
